holder_name: Daiwa House Asset Management Asia Pte. Ltd
title: Daiwa House Asset Management Asia Pte. Ltd receives 474K Daiwa House Logistics Trust units as management fees
body: Daiwa House Asset Management Asia Pte. Ltd received 473,518 units of Daiwa House Logistics Trust as payment of management fees, valued at S$0.4037 per unit, or S$191,159 in total. Total interest rises from 68,494,503 units (9.76%) to 68,968,021 units (9.82%).
remarks_text: Pursuant to the the trust deed constituting DHLT dated 2 November 2021 (the "Trust Deed"), DHLT has today issued 473,518 new Units (the "New Units") to DHAMA at the issue price of S$0.4037 per Unit as payment of base fees for the period from 1 July 2026 to 30 September 2026 (the "Payment Period"). The total number of Units in issue following the issuance of the New Units to DHAMA would be 702,060,754. In relation to Table 1 of item 8 of Part II, the percentage of total number of Units held "Immediately before the transaction" is based on 701,587,236  Units as at 26 November 2026 immediately prior to the issuance of the New Units to DHAMA and the percentage of total number of Units held "Immediately after the transaction" is based on 702,060,754 Units as at 26 November 2026 immediately after the issuance of the New Units to DHAMA.

title: Dr Shi Xu's stake in Nanofilm Technologies International Ltd rises to 52.00% from 51.98% after share buyback
body: Dr Shi Xu's stake in Nanofilm Technologies International Ltd moved from 51.98% to 52.00% after the company bought back shares. The transaction involved 246,800 shares. The number of shares held is unchanged at 337,050,426.
deemed_interest_text: (1) Dr Shi Xu is the sole shareholder of Pearl Yard Holdings Inc. ("Pearl Yard"). Accordingly, for the purposes of Section 4 of the Securities and Futures Act 2001 of Singapore ("SFA"), Dr Shi Xu is deemed to have an interest in 253,709,960 Shares held by Pearl Yard. (2) Dr Shi Xu holds 50% of the total issued shares in Neufront Investment Pte. Ltd. ("Neufront"). Accordingly, for the purposes of Section 4 of the SFA, Dr Shi Xu is deemed to have an interest in the 500,000 Shares held by Neufront. (3) In addition, for the purposes of Section 133(4) of the SFA, Dr Shi Xu is deemed to have an interest in 38,882,893 Shares in which his spouse, Mdm Jin Xiao Qun, has an interest, comprising (i) direct interests in 10,190,375 Shares, (ii) deemed interests in 28,192,518 Shares held by Harrymore International Limited and (iii) deemed interests in 500,000 Shares held by Neufront. However, to avoid double counting, the deemed interest of Dr Shi Xu disclosed in this Form 3 does not take into account the deemed interest which Mdm Jin has in the 500,000 Shares held by Neufront.
remarks_text: The percentage of shareholdings immediately before the transaction are calculated based on the Company's total issued shares of 648,406,488 (excluding treasury shares) as at 25 November 2026. The percentage of shareholdings immediately after the transaction are calculated based on the Company's total issued shares of 648,159,688 (excluding treasury shares) as at 25 November 2026. In this Notice, figures are rounded to the nearest 0.001%.
change_reason: the Company's share buy-back of 246,800 shares by way of market acquisition

title: Ong Ling Ling buys S$139K of Metro Holdings Ltd shares
body: Ong Ling Ling bought 392,800 shares of Metro Holdings Ltd in a market transaction at S$0.3529 per share, for a total of S$138,619. Total interest rises from 237,646,398 shares (28.70%) to 238,039,198 shares (28.75%).
remarks_text: In this notification, the shareholding percentage immediately before and after change is based on 828,035,874 issued shares (excluding treasury shares).

title: Cheng Wai Keung's deemed interest in Wing Tai Holdings Ltd rises after purchase of 45,000 shares
body: Cheng Wai Keung's deemed interest in Wing Tai Holdings Ltd rose after Chow Helen bought 45,000 shares. The direct holding is unchanged at 214,400 shares. Total interest rises from 489,192,859 shares (63.96%) to 489,237,859 shares (63.97%).
deemed_interest_text: The increase in deemed interest arises via acquisition of 45,000 WTH shares by Ms Chow Helen, spouse of Mr Cheng Wai Keung.
change_reason: the acquisition of 45,000 shares by the holder's spouse

title: Ravinder Sajwan buys S$31,678 of Ultragreen Ai Ltd shares
body: Ravinder Sajwan bought 67,000 shares of Ultragreen Ai Ltd in a market transaction at S$0.4728 per share, for a total of S$31,678. Total interest rises from 686,504,654 shares (62.48%) to 686,571,654 shares (62.49%).
deemed_interest_text: The business and affairs of IR Investments LP are managed by a board of managers (the “IR Board of Managers”). IR Holding Company Inc., the general partner of IR Investments LP, has on 15 December 2019 appointed Mr Sajwan as the sole and initial member of the IR Board of Managers. Mr Sajwan is also a Protector of The Saul Trust and a member of Saul Strategic Limited (which holds 100% of Saul Holdings Pte. Ltd.’s ordinary shares). Accordingly, for the purposes of the Securities and Futures Act 2001 of Singapore and the Securities and Futures (Disclosure of Interests) Regulations 2012, Mr Sajwan has a deemed interest in the Shares held by Renew Group Private Limited.
remarks_text: THE PERCENTAGE IN SHAREHOLDING IS CALCULATED BASED ON THE ISSUED SHARE CAPITAL OF 1,098,647,200  SHARES, EXCLUDING TREASURY SHARES, AS AT 25 NOVEMBER 2026.

title: Michelle Liem Mei Fung's deemed interest in Tuan Sing Holdings Ltd rises after S$381K share purchase
body: Michelle Liem Mei Fung's deemed interest in Tuan Sing Holdings Ltd rose after a party linked to the holder bought 1,466,800 shares in a market transaction at S$0.26 per share, for a total of S$381,368. No shares are held directly. Total interest rises from 767,889,329 shares (60.48%) to 769,356,129 shares (60.60%).
deemed_interest_text: Mdm Michelle Liem Mei Fung is deemed interested in the abovementioned shares held by Nuri Holdings (S) Pte Ltd and Greenpark Investments Pte Ltd by virtue of Section 4 of the Securities and Futures Act 2001.
remarks_text: The percentage before and after the change is calculated based on 1,269,601,474 issued shares (excluding treasury shares) in Tuan Sing Holdings Limited as at 25 November 2026.
